claims.claim_vi: Firecracker runs exactly one microVM per process, uses Linux KVM, and is launched through a jailer that prepares privileged resources; seccomp filters are loaded per thread before guest code runs.
claims.verified_by: design.md read at the pinned commit through raw.githubusercontent.com.

claims.claim_vi: Firecracker supports a steady mutation rate of 5 microVMs per host core per second and microVMs of up to 32 vCPUs; the document gives no boot-time or memory-overhead figure.
claims.verified_by: design.md read at the pinned commit; the lesson states no boot-time figure.

claims.claim_vi: Firecracker was developed at AWS to accelerate services like AWS Lambda and Fargate.
claims.verified_by: README read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Synchronous invocation waits for the result and pays environment creation and initialization on a cold start; asynchronous invocation acknowledges the event, queues it, and may retry on failure.
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against the current Lambda documentation: docs.aws.amazon.com could not be reached from the writing environment.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung bốn bước: đường đồng bộ và đường bất đồng bộ. Các thành phần nội bộ của Lambda (bộ điều phối, dịch vụ đặt chỗ, hàng đợi cụ thể) không vẽ vì không đối chiếu được với tài liệu.
source_deviations: Source names internal components (Worker Manager, Placement Service, Frontend, a queue service); the lesson keeps the two invocation paths and the microVM idea and does not name those components, because they were not checked against Lambda documentation.
The source's isolation-model diagram is not reproduced; the lesson explains the microVM from Firecracker's own design document.
The retry on failure and the cold-start explanation are the author's general knowledge, marked as unchecked in the lesson.
